generation.lineage_note: New works and wording; challenge shapes adapted from the seen V8 candidate. This set is exposed development material.

chapters.title: Badge Rule
chapters.body: The North Glass door opens only for a wearer of a blue badge; a red badge cannot open it.

chapters.title: Badge Roster
chapters.body: At 10点 on the same day, Mira tried the North Glass door while wearing only a red badge and carrying no blue badge; the roster does not record whether it opened.

chapters.title: Spare Register
chapters.body: The spare blue badge register leaves its 11点 holder field blank.

chapters.title: Carrier Ready Rule
chapters.body: A North Glass pneumatic carrier is ready for dispatch only when its pressure gauge reads four bars and its valve cap is locked.

chapters.title: Carrier Inspection
chapters.body: At 10点 on the same day, the North Glass pneumatic carrier gauge read four bars, but its valve cap remained loose and not locked throughout that minute.

chapters.title: Cap Actor
chapters.body: The carrier inspection does not record who loosened its valve cap.
